title: Tensor-Train Compressed Separable PINNs: A Curvature-Aware Optimization Framework for Parametric PDEs in High Dimensions
summary: In this work, we develop a second-order optimization framework for physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) applied to high-dimensional parametric partial differential equations (PDEs). The framework is built on the Gauss--Newton pullback metric, which provides an operator-informed notion of curvature in parameter space and connects the method to the broader family of natural gradient schemes.
